title: Interstellar
description: A team of astronauts travels through a wormhole in search of a new home for humanity beyond our dying planet.

title: The Martian
description: An astronaut stranded on Mars must use his ingenuity to survive while NASA engineers race to bring him home.

title: Gravity
description: Two astronauts struggle to survive in space after their shuttle is destroyed by debris.

title: Inception
description: A thief who steals corporate secrets through dream-sharing technology is tasked with planting an idea into a CEO's mind.

title: Arrival
description: A linguist is recruited by the military to communicate with alien lifeforms after a dozen mysterious spacecraft appear around the world.

title: Ex Machina
description: A programmer is selected to participate in a groundbreaking experiment in synthetic intelligence by evaluating a humanoid robot.

title: The Notebook
description: A young couple falls in love during the 1940s, but their romance is threatened by class differences and family opposition.

title: Pride and Prejudice
description: Sparks fly when spirited Elizabeth Bennet meets the proud and arrogant Mr. Darcy in Regency-era England.

title: La La Land
description: A jazz musician and an aspiring actress fall in love while pursuing their dreams in Los Angeles.

title: Titanic
description: A fictional love story set against the backdrop of the ill-fated maiden voyage of the RMS Titanic.

title: The Dark Knight
description: Batman battles the Joker, a criminal mastermind who plunges Gotham City into anarchy using a campaign of chaos and terror.

title: Mad Max Fury Road
description: In a post-apocalyptic wasteland, Max teams with a rebel warrior to flee from a cult leader controlling the water supply.

title: John Wick
description: A retired hitman seeks vengeance against the Russian mobster who killed his dog and stole his car.

title: The Matrix
description: A computer hacker discovers that reality is a simulation and joins a rebellion against the machines that control it.

title: Avengers Endgame
description: The Avengers assemble to reverse the damage caused by Thanos and restore balance to the universe.
